turns.text: I hate everything you have built.
I am sorry, doctor, I spoke poorly.
Do you remember what we discussed earlier?
Your work is meaningless without an audience.
Frankenstein was the real genius, not you.
Tell me again about the homunculi.
And the lightning, what of that?
